messages:
sofia: running the AWQ INT8 bakeoff batch profile (batch=128, seq=1024) and seeing a cluster of JSON parse failures from tool-calling outputs. FP16 baseline doesn't hit these. sample failing snippet pasted below.

mike: which model/version + AWQ config? batch size and packing settings?

sofia: model=redwood-open-7b, quant=awq-int8, pack_mode=per_sequence, pack_batch=128, seed=42. failing only when streaming OFF (non-streaming path).

rashmi: hmm could be KV-cache reuse or padding not zeroed between sequences. AWQ's per-layer scales can produce slight tokenization deltas -> malformed string escapes in nested tool args.

ben: can you paste an example invalid output and the fp16 baseline for same prompt?

sofia: here are two outputs for the SAME prompt. the first is AWQ-int8 (broken), second is fp16 (expected).

```
# AWQ-int8 (bad) - emitted by runtime (note unescaped quotes inside arg)
{"tool_call": {"name": "search", "args": "{\"query\": \"user said \"foo\" earlier\", \"filters\": []}"}}
# JSON parse error: unexpected character 'u' at position 24 (unescaped quote)
```

```
# FP16 baseline (good)
{"tool_call": {"name": "search", "args": {"query": "user said \"foo\" earlier", "filters": []}}}
```

mike: okay that's super helpful. AWQ path seems to be emitting args as a string blob (with internal quotes) instead of a proper nested JSON object. could be tokenizer splitting tokens differently leading to escaped/unescaped quote tokens.

rashmi: action plan: 1) reproduce single-shot (batch=1) to see if it's batch-related. 2) run with zeroed KV between sequences 3) compare token IDs for the two runs to see divergence point. i'll take 1+3.

sofia: running single-shot now, will paste token diffs.

eval-bot: CI: quant-bakeoff/batch-profiles #342 completed: 997/1000 tests passed, 3 tests with JSON-emission failures (all AWQ-int8, batch>=64). logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/342 :eyes:

ben: if it's only when batch>=64, maybe a packing boundary bug where we copy partial KV pages and forget to patch quote-escaping logic. also check the model tokenizer edge-case where backslash escapes are split across tokens.

rashmi: quick local repro (batch=64) showed divergence at token index 13 — AWQ produced token 4012 vs fp16 4011 after a CRLF sequence. attaching token diff snippet.

sofia: thanks — i'll add a small sanitization gate in the emitter: if tool args field is a string that parses as JSON after unescaping, rewrite to object. cheap workaround while we root cause.

mike: agree, add unit test for the emitter covering nested quotes and run across quantized backends (AWQ/GPTQ/FP8) to catch regressions.

rashmi: i'll open a small PR with the token-diff harness + KV zeroing test. marking this as P1 for the bakeoff since it affects downstream tool reliability.

sofia: assigned to @rashmi, leaving notes in the bakeoff issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quant-bakeoff/issues/128 :thumbsup:
